svg.title: TürkBizTel Order-to-Activation: Azure architecture as deployed
svg.desc: Users reach a VNet-integrated Azure Container App in Sweden Central through a public IP and load balancer. The app reads and writes Azure SQL Database and Blob Storage over private endpoints, calls Azure OpenAI and Azure Communication Services Email, pulls images from Azure Container Registry and logs to Log Analytics, all with a user-assigned managed identity.
svg.text: TürkBizTel Order-to-Activation · Azure architecture as deployed
Sweden Central · synthetic-data demonstrator · observed read-only from the live subscription on 20 November 2026
Consumption profile · external HTTPS ingress · VNet-integrated
FastAPI · 0.25 vCPU / 0.5 GiB · 1 replica · health probes
Portals: customer · partner · staff | REST (TMF-style) · MCP
Guarded supervisor orchestrating five specialist agents
Runs as user-assigned managed identity (no passwords)
Private DNS zones · linked to the VNet
HTTPS to public endpoint · Entra ID token
Email SDK · connection string held as a secret
Cognitive Services OpenAI User · SQL contained database user
No keys for data or AI: Entra tokens only (ACS uses a secret connection string)
1 HTTPS 443 to public IP and load balancer
2 TLS ingress to the single app replica
4 Advisor call to Azure OpenAI (Entra ID)
Subscription-level governance (created outside the Bicep template)
Microsoft Defender for Cloud: Defender for Storage (on-upload malware scan, sensitive-data
discovery, Event Grid system topic), Defender for SQL and Defender for AI
Azure Policy (subscription governance): subnet NSGs, OpenAI diagnostic
setting and SQL security alert policy
Data residency: this demonstrator runs in public Azure (Sweden Central) with synthetic data only. The production design keeps customer workloads on Azure Local in Türkiye and
uses external Azure services only for approved, non-customer data. See docs/azure-architecture.md.
Azure architecture icons © Microsoft, used per the Azure Architecture Center icon terms. Resource names are the real deployed names.
